title: Supervised Practicum I by Prior Learning Assessment (PLA)
description: Second-year practicum challenge. Present sufficient evidence of growing knowledge of CYC practice and prior practice experience which specifically demonstrates the learning objectives and outcomes required in CYC211.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CYC 210A, CYC 210, CYC 211.
Students in the Bachelor of Child and Youth Care program must earn a minimum grade of C+ in all pre- or co-requisites.

prerequisites.text: Admission to an undergraduate program in the School of Child and Youth Care
